candidates.teaser: There's a microscopic creature that survived naked in outer space — and it's probably living in your backyard right now.
candidates.video_title: This Tiny Animal Survived Naked in Outer Space
candidates.video_description: Tardigrades, also known as water bears, are microscopic animals that can survive in the vacuum of space, extreme radiation, and temperatures near absolute zero. Scientists sent them to space in 2007 and they came back alive. They might be the toughest creatures on Earth.
candidates.script: There is a creature so tough it has survived naked in the vacuum of outer space. It's called a tardigrade, or water bear, and it's smaller than a grain of sand. Scientists strapped thousands of them to a satellite in 2007, exposed them directly to space — no suit, no oxygen, full radiation — and brought them back. Most of them were still alive. These things also survive boiling water, deep-sea pressure, and temperatures close to absolute zero. The craziest part? Millions of them are probably living right now in your garden. So… how indestructible are you?

candidates.teaser: For over 600 years, the world's smartest codebreakers have tried to read this book — and every single one has failed.
candidates.video_title: No One Can Read This 600-Year-Old Book
candidates.video_description: The Voynich Manuscript is a medieval illustrated book written in a completely unknown language or code. Top cryptographers, linguists, and even World War II codebreakers have tried and failed to decipher it. Its origin and purpose remain completely unknown to this day.
candidates.script: There is a book that has never been decoded. Not by linguists, not by World War II cryptographers, not even by the most powerful AI systems today. The Voynich Manuscript is over 600 years old, filled with strange illustrations of unknown plants, naked figures, and astronomical diagrams — all written in a language no human has ever been able to identify. It follows real grammatical patterns, so it's not random nonsense. Someone wrote it deliberately. It was real to someone. Hundreds of scholars have dedicated their careers to cracking it — and every single one has failed. What do you think is hidden inside it?

candidates.topic: Clocks in casinos have no windows or clocks
candidates.teaser: Every casino in the world uses a secret design trick to make you lose track of time — and it works on almost everyone.
candidates.video_title: Why Casinos Have No Clocks or Windows
candidates.video_description: Casinos are deliberately designed with no clocks, no windows, and carefully controlled lighting to make visitors lose track of time and keep gambling longer. This psychological design principle is called the 'Gruen effect' and is also used in shopping malls and supermarkets.
candidates.script: Walk into any casino in the world and look around — you will not find a single clock. There are no windows either. The lighting never changes, whether it's noon or three in the morning. This is completely intentional. Casino designers engineer every detail so your brain loses track of time, keeping you at the table just a little longer. And it works. Studies show people gamble significantly longer in windowless, clockless environments. The wild part? The exact same psychological trick is used in shopping malls and supermarkets. Next time you're in a store and lose track of time — now you know why.

candidates.topic: Dying stars create gold and heavy metals
candidates.teaser: Every piece of gold on Earth was forged in a catastrophic explosion so violent, it briefly outshone entire galaxies.
candidates.video_title: All Gold on Earth Came From Exploding Stars
candidates.video_description: Gold and other heavy elements cannot be created inside ordinary stars. They are only forged during neutron star collisions and supernova explosions. Every gold ring, every gold coin, and every gold bar on Earth is ancient stardust from a violent cosmic event billions of years ago.
candidates.script: Every single piece of gold on Earth — your jewelry, coins, everything — was not made on this planet. Gold cannot be forged inside a regular star. It requires a force so extreme that only two neutron stars colliding can produce it. These are called kilonovas, and for a split second they release more energy than our entire galaxy. The gold created in that explosion drifts through space for billions of years, clumps together to form planets, and eventually ends up here. So that gold ring on someone's finger? It survived a cosmic explosion over four billion years ago. Kind of changes how you look at jewelry, doesn't it?

candidates.topic: Fingernails grow faster on dominant hand
candidates.teaser: Your body is doing something weird right now that changes depending on whether you're left or right-handed — and you never even noticed.
candidates.video_title: Why Your Nails Don't All Grow at the Same Speed
candidates.video_description: Fingernails grow faster on your dominant hand, and the middle finger grows faster than all other fingers. Nails also grow faster in summer, during the day, and on young people. Scientists believe blood circulation and mechanical stimulation from regular use drive this difference.
candidates.script: Your fingernails are not all growing at the same speed right now. The nails on your dominant hand grow measurably faster than the other hand. Your middle finger nail grows the fastest of all. Scientists think this happens because the hand you use more gets better blood circulation and constant mechanical stimulation from everyday tasks. Nails also grow faster during the day than at night, faster in summer than winter, and faster when you're young than when you're old. Your body is constantly tracking all of that without you knowing. Here's a question though — does biting your nails actually make them grow back faster, or is that just a myth?
